licence.scope: Transliteration text only. No Voynich script fonts or third-party annotations are copied.

acquisition.method: byte-preserving GitHub content API retrieval from an immutable archive commit
acquisition.note: Original URLs and headers were checked on voynich.nu. These files are pinned archived snapshots, not a claim of latest-version retrieval. No VCAT-derived annotations are used.

yale.attribution: Cipher manuscript (Voynich manuscript). General Collection, Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, Yale University.
yale.imagePolicy: Image URLs are indexed; full scans are not bundled. Images load on demand from Yale. Canvas labels are preserved; folio-side matches are label-derived candidates, not verified panel coordinates.
